blogs.title: Finetuning LLMs on a Single GPU: Meet QLoRA
blogs.description: Discover how QLoRA turns the seemingly impossible task of tuning a 65‑B parameter model into something feasible on an everyday NVIDIA card. We break down its key tricks—quantizing the base model to 4 bits, borrowing low‑rank adapters instead of full weight updates, and clever memory paging—so you can understand why this makes fine‑tuning affordable for researchers and hobbyists.

blogs.title: Cracking the 4‑bit Code: NF4 Quantization Explained
blogs.description: Who says you need full precision for big models? Learn what NormalFloat (NF4) is, why it’s mathematically optimal for normally distributed weights, and how it beats ordinary integer or float quantization. We’ll also touch on Double Quantization to squeeze even more save on GPU memory while keeping performance unchanged.

blogs.title: Adapter Layers Redefined: How Low‑Rank LoRA Makes Large Models Trainable
blogs.description: Low‑rank adapters (LoRA) let you tweak big models without touching their full weight tensors. This post walks through how LoRA works inside transformer layers, why you need adapters at every layer for top performance, and how QLoRA uses them to recover all the loss introduced by low‑bit quantization.

blogs.title: From Guanaco to ChatGPT: The New Benchmarks for Open‑Source Chatbots
blogs.description: Meet Guanaco—the open‑source chatbot that rivals ChatGPT on Vicuna benchmarks—thanks to QLoRA finetuning on OASST1 data. We’ll cover how the authors evaluated chat quality using both GPT‑4 automated scoring and human judgments, their Elo ranking system, and what the results mean for open AI tools.

blogs.title: Paging into Profit: Optimizer Memory Tricks for Big LLM Training
blogs.description: Gradient checkpointing can still hit GPU memory limits when training huge models. In this post we demystify NVIDIA’s unified memory paging feature that allows optimizer states to spill over to host RAM automatically—extending training beyond what standard GPUs could handle—and explain why it’s crucial for running QLoRA at scale.

blogs.title: Evaluating Chatbots Rightly? The Human vs GPT‑4 Debate
blogs.description: Why do model rankings shift when judged by humans versus GPT‑4? This piece dives into the constructed benchmark, shows ordering biases revealed by automated scoring, highlights agreement metrics (Elo, Kendall Tau), and offers practical takeaways for anyone building or testing next‑generation conversational agents.
